subject: Request: One-off credit infusion for BrightCart throughput dry run
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha@brightcart.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightCart SRE <sre@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 19:12:00 -0700
Subject: Throughput dry run — short night window + credits ask

Hi Logan / Jordan,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call today. We’re planning a focused throughput dry run this Thursday night (11/05) to validate tail latency and autoscale behavior at 18k qps for our realtime endpoint. The run is limited to a 6-hour window (01:00–07:00 PT) but will spike aggressively during ramp steps.

Two asks:
- One-off trial credit infusion of 75k token-equivalent to cover the spike and post-run telemetry exports.
- A 48-hour trial extension so our SREs can iterate on the client-side retry/backoff and re-run a short soak if needed.

Attached is our short POC plan and a sample telemetry CSV that shows the request mix. We’re on a tight timeline — the run is on Thursday night — so any help to provision earlier in the week is appreciated.

Related: HubSpot deal BRIGHT-487.

Best,
Asha Patel
Head of Platform Engineering | BrightCart
asha@brightcart.com

Attachments: brightcart-poc-plan.pdf (7 pages), telemetry-sample.csv (2k rows)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 20:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Throughput dry run — short night window + credits ask

Marissa — looping you in for quick approval path. BrightCart (BRIGHT-487) wants a 75k token one-off and 48h trial extension. They’ll run an intense 6h spike Thursday night to validate latency and autoscale.

Notes:
- Customer is in pilot, healthy telemetry from previous trials, good NPS.
- 75k tokens is non-trivial but should be covered by promotional bucket if we treat this as a short POC acceleration.
- Ops needs to be aware: Jordan, can we provision the extra quota and set an automated kill-switch at 110% spend? Also please confirm retention/access for telemetry exports.

If we can’t do the full 75k, suggest offering a 50k immediate infusion and a quick follow-up if they need a top-up after the first run. I’ll await your call.

— Logan
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0138
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Throughput dry run — short night window + credits ask

+Approve a controlled top-up.

Logan — authorize a 50k token infusion now and put BrightCart on a conditional path: we’ll give an additional 30k if they hit >=85% of the first allocation and provide the post-run telemetry within 24h. Jordan — please create a temporary quota object (BRIGHT-487-temp-20261104) that expires automatically 48 hours after the run and attach an automated alert to #sales-ops if usage exceeds 90%.

Cost note: charge promotional bucket for up to 50k; any additional will be reviewed against the deal margin. Communicate the conditional top-up to the customer and ask them to confirm the exact start time.

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Commercial Growth | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Throughput dry run — short night window + credits ask

Asha — quick update and confirmation.

We approved a controlled infusion: 50,000 token-equivalent available immediately for your Thursday night run. There’s a conditional reserve of up to +30,000 tokens if you consume >=85% of the initial allocation and upload the post-run telemetry within 24 hours (please use the Drive folder link). The temporary quota object BRIGHT-487-temp-20261104 will be in place and set to expire 48 hours after the run window. Jordan has set an automated alert to #sales-ops at 90% usage; we’ll also close the loop with you if the conditional top-up becomes available.

Action items for BrightCart:
- Confirm start time for the 6-hour window (we’ve tentatively held 01:00–07:00 PT).
- Upload post-run telemetry to the shared Drive link within 24h to trigger conditional top-up.
- Share any replay keys so our support engineers can look at tail-latency traces if you hit an anomaly.

HubSpot deal link: https://hubspot.com/deal/BRIGHT-487
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bexample

Thanks — I’ll monitor usage overnight.
